have h_main : multiply_postcond (a) (b) (multiply (a) (b) h_precond) h_precond := by
    constructor
    · -- Prove the first part: (a * b) - a * b = 0
      simp [multiply, h_precond, multiply_precond]
      <;> ring
      <;> simp_all
      <;> omega
    · -- Prove the second part: a * b - (a * b) = 0
      simp [multiply, h_precond, multiply_precond]
      <;> ring
      <;> simp_all
      <;> omega
  exact h_main
